title: Entergy Texas invests in the future workforce through STEM scholarships for students attending minority serving institutions

body_markdown:
Entergy Texas is investing in the future of higher education and workforce development by awarding a total of $10,000 in STEM scholarships to three outstanding students in the Greater Houston and Beaumont area. The scholarships are part of Entergy’s $20 Million Power of Prosperity initiative, which supports HBCUs and Minority-serving Institutions across the Gulf South to help remove barriers to students’ academic success.


The initiative pillars include academic scholarships, workforce development including student internships, mentoring and faculty externships; generational wealth-building; and competitive facility grants and endowments. Scholarships are awarded to students pursuing degrees in high-demand fields such as computer science, information technology, engineering and related disciplines that align with the evolving energy workforce.


**The 2026 scholarship recipients are:**


**Dorisa** **Nishimwe** – University of Houston, majoring in Computer and Information Sciences.


“I am proud and honored to receive the Entergy STEM Scholarship for the second year. The support Entergy provides has been immensely helpful, from the scholarship itself to the mentorship program I participated in during my first year. These opportunities have helped me continue excelling academically and growing as a student.”


**Alexander Puente** –


Lamar Institute of Technology, majoring in Chemical Process Technology


“I am committed to my goals, and this scholarship will help me reach them more quickly. My long-term goal is to complete my degree and obtain a meaningful career as a Process Operator. Receiving this scholarship will help reduce the financial stress of education and allow me to focus more on my classes. I am grateful to know there are companies like yours who want to help students succeed while easing the financial burden of school.”


**Ncube Methembe** **–** Lamar Institute of Technology, majoring in


Instrumentation Technology


“As a computer science student and someone deeply passionate about technology, I’m excited by the potential of AI to transform the way we live and work. At the same time, I’m passionate about the challenge of building the energy infrastructure needed to power that transformation sustainably. This scholarship will help me pursue my goal of working at the intersection of computing and energy, developing more efficient technologies and infrastructure to help power the AI revolution.”


The Competitive Facilities Grant portion of the program will provide up to $1 million in funding this year for accredited HBCUs and Minority Serving Institutions in Entergy’s service area to help upgrade classrooms, labs and equipment. Awards will be announced during the fall semester.


[Learn more here](https://www.entergy.com/news/entergy-makes-20m-commitment-empower-historically-black-colleges-universities-students) about Entergy’s Power of Prosperity program.


**About Entergy Texas**


Entergy Texas provides electricity to approximately 538,000 customers in 27 counties. Entergy generates, transmits and distributes electricity to power life for more than 3 million customers through our operating companies in Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi and Texas. Its customers are connected to the Midcontinent Independent System Operator Inc. power grid, which is a regional transmission organization responsible for administering the transmission systems of member utilities in 15 states stretching across the central region of the United States and Manitoba, Canada. We’re focused on keeping costs for our customers as low as possible while providing reliable energy that our communities count on. We’re also investing in growth for the future with a more resilient, cleaner energy system that includes modern natural gas, nuclear and renewable energy generation. As a nationally recognized leader in sustainability and corporate citizenship, we deliver more than $100 million in economic benefits each year to the communities we serve through philanthropy, volunteerism and advocacy. Entergy is a Fortune 500 company headquartered in New Orleans, Louisiana, and has approximately 12,000 employees. Learn more at


[EntergyTexas.com](https://www.entergytexas.com/) and connect with


[@EntergyTX](https://www.entergy.com/social) on social media.
